reference.title: Scenario 19 — Table Between Numbered List in a Procedure
reference.shortdesc: Consider a procedure where the author inserts a configuration table between two numbered steps to

section.p: Consider a procedure where the author inserts a configuration table between two numbered steps to provide reference information before the next action.

row.entry: [Heading 2]: Configure the Server [List Number]: Open the server configuration file. [Caption]: Server parameters [Table Header]: Parameter │ Value [Row]: Port │ 8080 [Row]: Timeout │ 60 [List Number]: Save the configuration file.

entry.codeblock:
Configure the Server Open the server configuration file. Server parameters Parameter Value Port 8080 Timeout 60
Save the configuration file.

section.p: Result: The converter associates the table with the preceding procedural step and places all supporting content inside <step><info>.
Similarly, consider the table represents the options that the user must select from after a step.

table.title: Table of selectable options in procedure

row.entry: [Heading 2]: Configure the Server Mode [List Number]: Select the server mode. [Normal]: Use the following table to choose the correct mode. [Table Header]: Option │ Description [Row]: Development │ Use for development and testing. [Row]: Production │ Use for live customer traffic. [List Number]: Save the configuration.

entry.codeblock:
Configure the Server Mode Select the server mode.

Use the following table to choose the correct mode.

 Option Description Development Use for development and testing. Production Use for live customer traffic. Save the configuration.

section.p: Result: The table is mapped to <choicetable> because it presents options that the user must choose from while performing the step, rather than a plain reference table.
